description: An application submitted under Section 96a of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 for a non-material amendment in connection with the planning permission dated 23/09/2026 application reference 25/3073/F for "Mixed use phased redevelopment of the site to provide residential development at ground level and above, including flexible commercial uses (Class E) at ground floor, together with associated vehicle access, servicing, car/cycle parking, landscaping and public realm improvements and other associated site clearance and enabling works, as well as temporary works necessary to enable the approved development", to consist of amendments to: Condition 2 'Approved drawings' to allow amendments to elevations and floor layouts, landscaping and add update reports / notes regarding design changes, noise, overheating, DSO and EIA Statement of Conformity; Condition 3 'Quantum of development and height of buildings' to amend figures for residential GIA and max storey heights of plantCondition 6 'Phasing plan' to replace drawing '3024-JWA-ZZ-ZZ-D-A-1015 Rev P01' to reflect minor changes to the Phase 1 boundary Condition 29 'Details of residential cycle parking', to update to the adopted Support for housebuilding LPG Condition 37 'Landscape and Ecological Management Plan' to marginally amend the UGF figureCondition 47 'Energy and CO2', part (d) to add reference that Zone A will be carried out in accordance with the update Overheating report submittedCondition 67 'Daylight and sunlight' to add reference that Zone A will be carried out in accordance with the update DSO report submitted;
